review.notes: The agenda names 'Alliant Insurance Services, Inc.', which exactly matches the legal entity name on alliant.com. The about-us and public entity/K-12 pages support the summary (broker and consultant, benefits, reinsurance, underwriting, public entity and K-12 programs), and a K-12 insurance broker fits OUSD's student accident premium payments.
